name: Lactaid Cookies & Cream Ice Cream (100% Lactose-Free)
whyItWorks: Real, velvety dairy cream and milk treated with lactase enzyme so that 100% of the lactose is broken down into simple glucose and galactose. Blended with soft chocolate cookie crumbs that melt easily without nuts.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Serve 1/2 cup portion chilled. Delivers all the authentic creaminess of real ice cream without lactose distress.
